stem:
Meera's grandmother does not have a clock in the kitchen. She wants to measure the time needed to boil milk. She thinks of using different processes happening around her.

Which process can be used to measure time?

options.text: Water dripping from a loose tap at irregular intervals.
A swing moving back and forth at a steady, constant rate.
A crow calling outside the window every now and then.
The ceiling fan slowing down after it is switched off.

teacher.key_rationale: Only a process that repeats continuously after definite, equal intervals can mark equal units of time. A steadily swinging swing (like a pendulum) repeats at a constant rate, so counting its swings measures elapsed time. The other processes are irregular or non-repeating, so they cannot mark equal intervals.
